notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024. Documents read on sec.gov: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001141391-25-000011) and 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001141391-25-000078). AJAY BANGA was CEO until 2020 (the proxy's pay-versus-performance note: '2020: Mr. Banga served as our PEO'). He is not a director or named executive officer in the 2025 proxy and does not appear in its ownership tables, so status is no-reported-stake. HOLDER PERCENTAGES are as the proxy states them: percent of Class A common stock outstanding (902,487,192 shares on April 7, 2025). Class B (about 7 million shares, under 1% of the total) is not in the denominator, so the stated figures are very slightly above each holder's share of all shares. asOf for each holder is the Schedule 13G/A filing date the proxy cites (the proxy does not give the event dates); the Vanguard and BlackRock figures are from February 2024 filings and are stale. The Foundation's type is 'other' (a Canadian charitable foundation's asset manager). BUYBACKS: the FY2024 10-K cash-flow figure ($11,035 million) is used; a later filing (the FY2025 10-K) restates 2024 at $10,954 million in XBRL, which is not used. The proxy states each director and executive officer, and the group, owns less than 1% of Class A. The ESPP is recorded from the 10-K exhibit index; the 10-K reviewed gives no participation figures.

ecosystem.notes: The 10-K states GDV rounded, as $9.8T. It also gives three program rows (Consumer Credit, Consumer Debit and Prepaid, Commercial Credit and Debit), which were not added up. GDV is the spend on Mastercard-branded cards, and the 10-K notes that the GDV data is 'provided by Mastercard customers'. Mastercard is a network, not a marketplace: issuing banks, acquirers and merchants keep most of the economics, so net revenue divided by GDV is a network fee rate, not a share of the sale. GDV excludes Maestro and Cirrus.
